users: researchers and facilities stakeholders examining declared retail-building flexibility scenarios
supported_tasks: build an OpenStudio SuperMarket screening baseline
inspect climate and operating-condition screening context
not_intended_for: a calibrated individual-store digital twin, utility-bill savings claim, refrigeration-safety claim, customer-operation claim, or operating recommendation

outputs: energy, demand, operating-condition, and comfort-related scenario metrics

limitations: Generated models are not independently validated or representative of an individual store without site evidence.
The public Decision Studio contains screened prototype outputs, not generated model files or simulation outputs.
